title: Design: A long payer name shows in full on the phone Customer card
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide, signed in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, a payer, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, the customer the work is for.
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer D, in Estimate, billed to customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer D, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p2-21-after-s2-17579.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Tap to open the work order details.
  3. Open work order 2.
  4. Tap to open the work order details.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer D, in the phone layout.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows "Bill To" under Authorizer with customer A's whole name: every character can be read.
  • The name stays inside the card: no part of it runs past the right edge of the screen.

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 opens for customer D.

Step 4:

  • "Bill To" shows customer B's whole name: every character can be read.
  • The name stays inside the card: no part of it runs past the right edge of the screen.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • Story 3, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized: the same Customer card on phones; the field is a standard searchable select with no hover-only control.”
  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "S2-17579" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-21-after-s2-17579.png

The design's own words:

  • “The same card, with "Bill To" "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" under Authorizer. Nothing phone-only.”

On the phone the design draws the whole Bill To name on the card (its words above); the design draws ordinary names only, so the long names follow the design-case checklist (lesson L-21).
